name: service-card
title: Service card
description: A bookable service: name, what is included, and duration and price as a labelled pair, with a select or book action and a from-price state.
docs: duration is a number of minutes (written '45 min', '1 h 30 min') or your own words ('Half a day'); price is a number written in the currency and locale you name, with whole amounts losing their cents and 0 saying 'Free', or your own words ('On request'). Duration and price are a description list, so a screen reader hears 'Duration: 45 min' and 'Price: from €60, 3 options'. priceFrom, or options of two or more, writes 'from' before the price and counts the options after it. includes is a short check list and badge puts a word beside the name. Giving onSelect or selected makes the action a toggle with aria-pressed, controlled with selected or uncontrolled with defaultSelected: picked, it shows a check, a heavier border and 'Selected', and the whole card is a place to click. The action is named with the words on it and then the service ('Select Colour and tone', 'Selected Colour and tone'), so a voice control that says what it sees reaches it. With href and no onSelect the action is a link, 'Book'; with both, the name links to href. unavailable is the reason a service cannot be booked: it is written on the card, the card mutes, and the action is aria-disabled and described by the reason, so keyboard users still find it and hear why. labels carries every word.
